title: Pure Noble Knight
summary: Noble Knights led by the Infernoble Knight Synchro line, with a few Arthurian Knights and generic staples. The page covers both factions; this list follows its modern combo because the Infernoble side has the newer support. Infernoble Knight Ogier sends a FIRE Warrior or Noble Arms card from the Deck, and Renaud, Roland, Ricciardetto and Turpin summon, equip and recover each other. Captain Roland climbs to Infernoble Knight Emperor Charles, which destroys a card whenever an Equip Card is equipped. The 2023 cards Ricciardetto, Turpin, The Continuing Epic of Charles and Emperor Charles the Great add a Tuner, an extra body, a Deck summon and a Spell/Trap negate. Wonko, Noble Knight of the Forest, the newest Noble Knight, draws a card and keeps attacks on itself; its search needs Fairy Tale Prologue: Journey's Dawn, which this list doesn't run. Isolde, Two Tales of the Noble Knights is Forbidden in the TCG.
main: Infernoble Knight Ogier
Starter: sends a FIRE Warrior or Noble Arms card from the Deck; equips from the GY.
Infernoble Knight - Renaud
Summons itself as a Tuner next to a FIRE Warrior; recovers a FIRE Warrior or Equip Spell.
Infernoble Knight - Roland
Equips from the hand; sent to the GY, searches a FIRE Warrior or Equip Spell.
Infernoble Knight Ricciardetto
Tuner: summons a FIRE Warrior from the hand or revives one from the GY.
Infernoble Knight Turpin
Summons itself next to an equipped monster; makes the equipped monster a Tuner.
Infernoble Knight Oliver
Tuner: summons itself by sending a FIRE Warrior or Equip Spell; equips from the GY.
Infernoble Knight Astolfo
Summons itself by banishing a FIRE Warrior; comes back with another.
Infernoble Knight Maugis
Recycles three FIRE Warriors or Noble Arms for a draw; equips from the GY.
Noble Knight Medraut
Summons a Noble Knight from the Deck when equipped and alone.
Noble Knight's Spearholder
Tributes itself to search an Equip Spell; turns a monster into a Tuner.
Wonko, Noble Knight of the Forest
Newest Noble Knight: draws when summoned; the only monster they can attack while a Field Spell is out.
"Infernoble Arms - Durendal"
Equip: searches a Level 5 or lower FIRE Warrior; revives one from the GY.
"Infernoble Arms - Joyeuse"
Equip: recovers a FIRE Warrior; summons one from the hand.
Heritage of the Chalice
Searches any Noble Knight monster or Noble Arms card.
Glory of the Noble Knights
Quick-Play: equips a Noble Knight with an Equip Spell from the Deck.
The Continuing Epic of Charles
Reveals a Noble Arms to summon an Infernoble Knight from the Deck.
extra: Level 9: destroys a card whenever an Equip Card is equipped; re-equips every End Phase.
Link-1 on an equipped Emperor Charles: negates a Spell/Trap.
Level 5 Synchro Tuner: mills an Equip Spell to search a Warrior; equips from the GY.
Level 5: revives itself as a Tuner and destroys a card on attack.
Artorigus, King of the Noble Knights
Rank 4: equips Noble Arms from the GY and destroys Spells/Traps.
Sacred Noble Knight of King Custennin
Rank 4: detaches to bounce their cards; brings out another Noble Knight Xyz when it falls.
